findings.title: Read-like topology access triggers full flat synchronization
findings.detail: buildTopology synchronizes edgeListDirty before checking a clean existing backend. Mutable get marks edgeListDirty=true. Every following get can therefore walk V/E, allocate vertexMap and new arrays and install attributes. Halfedge isActive/getId/end/size and nested navigation use this mutable overload; loops can multiply full-graph synchronization by traversal length. Severity/scaling follows source; time dominance remains a native measurement hypothesis.

findings.title: Synchronization compacts active IDs while keeping the backend
findings.detail: syncEdgeList skips inactive vertices/edges and invalid endpoints, renumbers flat endpoints, then leaves topologyDirty=false with original backend IDs/links. Vertex/edge iterator activity uses flat index ranges. Changing read intent can change when compaction happens; preserve activity and ID observations before optimizing. Mixed-ID runtime failures are hypotheses until fixture reproduction.

findings.title: Bulk geometry and edge iterator geometry already use flat storage
findings.detail: Do not claim a new halfedge-removal speedup here. Remaining costs include small vector allocations, copy-out APIs, bounds positions copy and synchronization inherited from prior topology access. Halfedge geometry/attribute wrappers still construct/synchronize topology.

findings.title: Flat lookup and backend maps have different contracts
findings.detail: Flat position search is first-match factorized distance; flat unordered endpoint lookup is first edge. Backend rounded string maps overwrite duplicates; directed self-edge key is overwritten by the symmetry entry. Cache public flat lookup semantics, not mesh last-match semantics. Failed scalar halfEdgeExists returns without resetting outHalfEdgeId; preserve it.

findings.title: Ordering depends on geometry, angle ties and stored fan seed
findings.detail: Topology fan order follows angular sort and prev.sym, beginning at the last assigned incident halfedge. Ordered connected lists, BFS parents and ribbon output require this exact order. Flat smoothing/color/dynamics use edge insertion order instead; a single generic adjacency cache would conflate these semantics.

findings.title: Construction/copy/install allocation candidates
findings.detail: Lazy build validates, copies positions/connectivity, pushes topology arrays/handles/maps, copies positions again and overwrites defaults with attrs. Reserves are commented out. Sync builds defaults before overwriting attributes. Impl deep-copies both forms and dirty flags; getDuplicate rebuilds only compact flat data. Move install/reserve candidates need measured allocation benefit and exact default/copy behavior.

findings.title: All flat edits invalidate topology; raw writes escape tracking
findings.detail: Position, attribute and raw-pointer access all use edit(), resetting backend. Retained raw pointers can become stale after sync/install/reallocation; halfedge raw color points into a different representation. Finer revisions or retained topology require authoritative read/write ownership and pointer alias tests; no new lifetime guarantees should be promised.

findings.title: BFS duplicate scans and dense eccentricity computation
findings.detail: BFS scans complete output and next-level vectors for duplicates; membership stamps can preserve first discovery order after the synchronization boundary is resolved. Eccentricity allocates N*N ints and performs cubic Floyd-Warshall, INF=99999. At V=500001 the distance matrix alone is ~1.0 TB decimal; do not run this case. BFS eccentricity replacement is a separate algorithm proposal with disconnected/long-distance/self-edge compatibility gates.

findings.title: Correctness hazards must stay separate from optimization
findings.detail: addEdges bounds guards use impossible && checks; removeInactive active branches never advance and erase invalidates vector iterators; public precision/normal creation parameters do not affect lazy topology; isolated vertex getHalfEdge throws before connected-list early return. Record and test existing behavior; repairs need a separately approved scope, not silent changes.

findings.title: No direct graph handle ABI; C++ live-sketch draw is a graph consumer
findings.detail: WASM build recursively compiles graph core/interface sources. Bridge has no dedicated Graph handle/query/import ABI, but live_sketch.h draw(graph) copies five flat arrays and emits point/line draw structs; zspace_sketch_build exports those primitive buffers. The default compiled sketch submits no geometry. JS ZSpaceJsObjectGraph copies/expands in JS; toolsets C-Tubes graph inputs use JSON/FS in a separate heap and return meshes. Verify which installed custom sketch/runtime reaches C++ graph before claiming viewer acceleration.

findings.title: Actual viewer graph conversion is measurable at 500000 edges
findings.detail: Report-only harness bundles actual current objects.ts in memory. At 500001 vertices / 500000 edges, conversion median and single primitive clone median are recorded across five trials. No browser/GPU/native execution. Expanded payload is 26 MB edge buffers plus 14,000,028 bytes point buffers, total 40,000,028 bytes; temporaries and retained copies add memory. Array/RSS deltas are observations, not peak memory.

findings.title: Native display, IO, fields and interop indirect consumers
findings.detail: Native draw copies five arrays and creates per-edge endpoint containers; appendToBuffer copies indices/attrs. IO uses flat functionsets: TXT checks endpoint bounds, JSON v1 parses integer connectivity without equivalent pair/range validation. JSON preserves colors; graph weight IO is absent. Empty/no-edge graph IO and USD graph IO are rejected. Mesh dual graph uses halfedge size and repeated public edge lookup; field polygon walks directed links. Rhino/Maya exports use halfedge endpoints and can amplify sync costs; optional interop is not enabled/verified in this audit.

sequence.title: Capture baseline and approve compatibility scope
sequence.changes: Add report/test-only fixtures and phase instrumentation; reproduce sync counts, activity/ID observations, exceptions and pathological cases using bounded subprocesses. Build current native Release and tests; save source/runtime hashes before any implementation.
sequence.gate: No algorithm/output changes. Decide separately whether correctness repairs are authorized; user constraint currently requires existing exceptions/numerical behavior.

sequence.title: Small read-only topology boundary patch
sequence.changes: Introduce internal read access only where full sync was caused by a pure read, keeping mutation and pointer-escape paths explicit. Begin with halfedge loop bounds/activity/navigation on validated all-active graphs; retain legacy fallback wherever compact-ID behavior differs.
sequence.gate: Exact pre/post ID/link/activity/attribute/exception parity across mixed sequences and inactive fixtures. Preserve synchronization side effects observable by public flat calls; no blanket const replacement. Instrument builds/syncs and reject patch if parity cannot be preserved.

sequence.title: Remove local allocations and copies
sequence.changes: Direct scalar flat endpoint reads for edge geometry without temporary zIntArray; bounds reference fast path with alias fallback; reserve bulk outputs internally where clear/append semantics allow. Separately propose viewer pre-sized typed line buffers only if viewer scope is approved.
sequence.gate: Byte/exact numerical parity, edge vector a-b versus even halfedge b-a, output append behavior, aliases, invalid-input exceptions. Viewer conversion baseline supports this candidate; core gains remain unmeasured.

sequence.title: First-match flat lookup cache and construction reservations
sequence.changes: Packed unordered endpoint index storing first edge; optional quantized position candidate buckets with original ordered distance checks. Reserve topology arrays/handles/maps before create; internal move storage installation only after profiling.
sequence.gate: Duplicates, reversed pairs, self edges, signed zero/precision, last-versus-first semantics, retained raw writes, invalidation/copy; identical IDs/directions/default attrs. Position hash cannot replace exact distance search without proof.

sequence.title: Two incidence contracts, then BFS membership
sequence.changes: Reuse compact insertion-order incidence for averageVertices/color/dynamics. Keep cyclic adjacency backed by authoritative directed links; consider lightweight cyclic records only after exact angle/order tests. Replace BFS membership scans with stamps while preserving level/discovery/parent order.
sequence.gate: Exact sum order/self incidence and duplicate multiplicity; geometric order with angle ties, loops, branches, 3D/XY normal behavior, local edits and isolated exceptions. No full topology redesign.

sequence.title: Measured remaining boundaries
sequence.changes: Only after earlier evidence: native display copy reduction, dynamics hinge incidence, separate eccentricity algorithm proposal, toolsets runtime consumer rebuild, viewer reconstruction/history. Keep unrelated selection/display fixes excluded.
sequence.gate: Rebuild reachable WASM consumers; backup installed runtime; verify actual viewer import/display/camera/undo/redo. Do not mark roadmap until checks pass or infer FPS from Node/rAF.
